meta.title: A live RFQ: "Are you sure you want to create a new version?": "Cancel" closes it and changes nothing

plan.title: Live RFQ Create New Version Cancel

steps.note: Start on the prepared live RFQ responses tab
Open the event settings gear menu
Click Create New Version in the settings menu
Click Cancel on the confirmation modal

args.name: Are you sure you want to create a new version?

steps.note: Assert the confirmation modal is closed
